blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions on Dry & Dehydrated Skin Treatment
blocks.html: Frequently Asked Questions on Dry & Dehydrated Skin Treatment

items.q: How do I know if I have dry skin or dehydrated skin?
items.a: Dry skin is a skin type that lacks oil, while dehydrated skin is a condition that lacks water. You may experience tightness, flakiness, or dullness. During our consultation, our therapists will assess your skin type and condition before recommending the right treatment.

items.q: Will one facial be enough to fix my dehydrated skin?
items.a: One facial can give instant hydration, but dehydrated skin needs consistent care. For long-lasting results, we usually recommend a series of treatments and a good at-home routine. We’ll guide you on what works best for your skin’s recovery.

items.q: Can I wear makeup after the facial?
items.a: It’s best to let your skin breathe for at least 6–8 hours post-facial, but yes — you can wear makeup after that if needed. We recommend a light, hydrating base instead of heavy foundation right after.
